keywords: EVMification EIP-8200 用字节码替换预编译
EIP-8175 加入 Falcon-512 后量子签名
RISC-V zkVM 严重漏洞披露
summary: kevaundray 提交 EVMification（EIP-8200），用等价字节码替换 RIPEMD-160、BLAKE2f 与 BLS12 map to curve 等预编译。Giulio2002 为 EIP-8175 可组合交易加入 Falcon-512 作为第三种签名类型，提交。fede_intern 的团队披露一个主流 RISC-V zkVM 的严重安全漏洞并公开 PoC。

summary_en: kevaundray submitted EVMification (EIP-8200), replacing precompiles such as RIPEMD-160, BLAKE2f and BLS12 map to curve with equivalent bytecode. Giulio2002 submitted Falcon-512 as a third signature type for EIP-8175 composable transactions. fede_intern's team disclosed a critical vulnerability in a leading RISC-V zkVM and released the PoC.
